summary: Comprehensive backend regression for BlingDrop API. 23/23 pytest tests passed covering JWT auth, Google session-token (cookie+bearer), products CRUD, seed (idempotent), sync validation rules (title>60, <6 bullets, missing Shopee weight, out-of-stock), dashboard stats with stock divergences, integrations toggle, and AI (Claude+GPT) for title/bullets/description.

minor.issue: set_cookie uses samesite='none' with secure=True - works behind HTTPS proxy but cookies will be rejected on plain HTTP/local testing. Acceptable for prod.
First call inserts default doc but mutates dict in place; minor - works because pop happens after insert. No functional issue.
Always returns total_available=3 even after creation; consider returning total_in_db for clarity (not a bug).
Does not reset sync_status back to 'pending' when content changes (only sets out_of_stock). Stale 'synced'/'error' status may persist after edits.

action_items: Consider resetting sync_status to 'pending' in PUT /api/products/{id} when title/bullets/weight change so stale 'synced' badge doesn't mislead UI.
Cookie samesite='none' + secure=True is correct for cross-site preview URL; ensure frontend uses fetch with credentials:'include' for /auth/session and /auth/me when relying on cookie.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 794 lines - approaching limit. Consider splitting auth/products/ai into separate routers/modules.
AI prompts are hard-coded inside endpoints; extract to a prompts module for reuse and easier i18n.

_llm_generate raises HTTPException 500 if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing but does not catch LLM provider errors - any provider exception bubbles as 500 with generic message; wrap with try/except returning 502 + provider hint.
sync_product hardcodes Brazilian timestamp format inline; consider helper.
No rate-limiting / abuse protection on /api/ai/* (each call spends LLM credits).
Pydantic ProductIn has wide defaults (e.g., empty bullets list of 6) - good; but no length validation of images URLs.
test_credentials: Tests register a unique user per run (test+<uuid>@blingdrop.com / Test1234!). Standard test account test@blingdrop.com / Test1234! per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/products/seed creates 3 mock JohnDrop products per user. Tests also create transient TEST_<uuid> SKUs for validation flows; not auto-cleaned but isolated per test user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. backend_test.py covers all endpoints incl. AI (real Claude+GPT calls via Emergent LLM Key, ~15s). Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. For Google auth flow, test seeds session_token directly into MongoDB user_sessions collection and verifies both cookie and Bearer paths.
